data.r_code:
# Epilogue for CR-001
# Defensive checks
required_objs <- c('sc','Xs','pd','decision','cf','fit')
missing_objs <- required_objs[!sapply(required_objs, exists)]
if (length(missing_objs) > 0) {
  stop(paste('Missing required objects:', paste(missing_objs, collapse=', ')))
}
# Prepare frame.csv (raw inputs)
frame <- sc
frame$.row <- seq_len(nrow(frame))
write.csv(frame, file = '/work/out/frame.csv', row.names = FALSE)
# Prepare scores.csv
scores <- data.frame(.row = seq_len(length(pd)),
                     score = pd,
                     decision = decision,
                     stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
write.csv(scores, file = '/work/out/scores.csv', row.names = FALSE)
# Prepare coef.csv (already in cf)
coef_df <- data.frame(term = names(cf), estimate = unname(cf), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
write.csv(coef_df, file = '/work/out/coef.csv', row.names = FALSE)
# Bundle paths and objects
export_bundle <- list(
  model_name = 'CR-001 Retail PD Scorecard',
  frame_path = '/work/out/frame.csv',
  scores_path = '/work/out/scores.csv',
  coef_path = '/work/out/coef.csv',
  fit = fit,
  cf = cf
)
saveRDS(export_bundle, file = '/work/out/export_bundle.rds')
data.explanation: The legacy script reads the scoring file into the data frame `sc`; this contains the raw input columns exactly as the model saw them, so we use `sc` (with an added `.row` column) for `frame.csv`. The script already computes the predicted probabilities `pd` and the decision vector `decision`, which we combine with a matching `.row` index to create `scores.csv`. Coefficients are available in `cf`, which we write to `coef.csv`. Because the logistic model was fitted on the entire training set (`fit` uses all rows of `dat`), no `train_rows.csv` is needed. Finally we package the paths and key objects into `export_bundle.rds` for downstream consumption.
